study_identification_part.si_4_title: Molecular and micro-architectural mapping of gray matter alterations in psychosis

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Generalized Additive Models for Location, Scale, and Shape (GAMLSS) were used to estimate normative trajectories. The study utilized the pre-trained BrainChart models (Bethlehem et al., 2022) and applied an out-of-sample method to calculate centiles for the current cohorts, estimating study-specific offsets (random effects) for the mean, variance, and skewness of the distribution.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: To benchmark regional volumes of each psychosis-related diagnosis and group against normative trajectories, we used a generalized additive model for location, scale, and shape (GAMLSS) [40]. This model ... estimated cross-sectional normative age-related trends ... age-normed and sex-stratified measures ... known as centiles ... could be derived ... after adjusting for scanning site offset. ... The out-of-sample centile method used here enabled us to calculate centiles without the need to re-train the model ... estimating the study specific offsets (random effects) for three moments ... mean (μ), variance (σ), and skewness (ν) in an age- and sex-specific manner.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: GarciaSanMartin2025.pdf.md: Subjects and Methods / Centile and effect sizes estimation and analysis; GarciaSanMartin2025_sup1.docx.md: Supplementary Subjects and Methods / Centile-based normative model

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Regional cortical volumes (34 Desikan-Killiany regions, averaged across hemispheres).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: generated centile scores for cortical gray matter (GM) phenotypes, identifying deviations in regional volumes ... only 34 DK regional centiles (instead of 68) could be derived for each individual. ... models provided by Bethlehem et al. [20] were only available for cortical brain volume averaged across hemispheres (not subcortical volume, cortical thickness, or surface area).
nm2_2_response_variable.location: GarciaSanMartin2025.pdf.md: Subjects and Methods / Centile and effect sizes estimation and analysis; GarciaSanMartin2025_sup1.docx.md: Supplementary Subjects and Methods / Centile-based normative model

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and Sex were used as covariates for the normative trajectories. Site was included as a random effect (offset) to account for scanner/study differences.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: standardized by age-, sex- and site-effect. ... estimating the study specific offsets (random effects) for three moments ... mean (μ), variance (σ), and skewness (ν) in an age- and sex-specific manner.
